SEVERITY: 0.75
FLAW_CLASS: 4
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.65
DESCRIPTION: The immune response layer has no visibility into LoadBalancer feasibility warnings, allocation imbalances, or token-limit violations. Model failures (timeout, underperform) caused by infeasible allocations (task load > L_m) or severe imbalance are diagnosed as model pathologies without considering the allocator's role. The LoadBalancer's `_allocation_warnings` and feasibility probability metrics are not passed to the health monitor, creating a systemic blind spot. This violates the CDSFL proportionality gate: ignoring a primary failure cause (allocation infeasibility) that downstream verification won't catch.
PROPOSED_FIX: Extend `process_round()` to capture LoadBalancer warnings and feasibility probabilities; feed them as evidence to `DetectorHealthMonitor.record_model_round()`. Add a new pathology `"allocation_infeasible"` with remediation chain adjusting `feasibility_threshold`, `lambda_bal`, or token limits. Ensure P-pass gating includes allocation-side checks before blaming model.
VERIFIED: FALSE
